mechanics.name: Troubleshooter
mechanics.currentEffect: While chased by the Killer, reveals the Aura of the Generator with the most progress. After you drop a Pallet, reveals the Killer's Aura for 4/5/6 seconds. The effects linger for 6/8/10 seconds after the Chase ends, then the perk deactivates.
activation: Be chased by the Killer to reveal the most-progressed Generator.
Drop a Pallet during the effect to reveal the Killer's Aura.
Ends/deactivates when: Effects linger for 6/8/10 seconds after the Chase ends, then deactivate.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (unknown): No material live balance change could be verified from available patch history.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: During and briefly after a chase, shows the most-progressed Generator and can reveal the Killer after you drop a Pallet.
duration: Killer Aura reveal after dropping a Pallet: 4/5/6 seconds.
Perk linger after Chase ends: 6/8/10 seconds.
specialInteractions: The Generator Aura shown is the one with the most progress at activation.

editorial.summary: While chased, see the most-progressed Generator; after dropping a Pallet, see the Killer for up to 6 seconds, with both effects lingering briefly after chase.
useCases: Avoid dragging the Killer onto the team's most important generator.
Read the Killer through walls after pallet drops to win mindgames.
Use the linger after chase to reposition around the most-progressed objective.
counters: Requires being in chase for the generator Aura effect.
Pallet Aura read only happens after you drop a pallet.
Strong direct-vision Killers may reduce the need for the information.
pros: Excellent beginner and Solo Q chase information.
Protects team macro while helping tile-level mindgames.
cons: No direct speed or health-state protection.
Information only matters if the user can act on it.
analysis: Troubleshooter remains one of the cleaner mid-tier information perks because both halves solve real Survivor mistakes. The most-progressed Generator Aura tells the chased player exactly where not to route the Killer.

After a pallet drop, the Killer Aura read removes much of the guesswork from the next few seconds of the loop. That is particularly helpful at tall or visually cluttered structures where standard mindgames depend on losing sight.

The perk is very friendly to developing players because it teaches both chase and macro habits. Experienced players still get value, but often know the same information through game sense or communication.
It stays in B because it never creates raw distance. The perk improves decisions rather than changing the physics of the chase.
editorial.verdict: A superb learning and Solo Q information perk. Troubleshooter makes both chase routing and pallet mindgames cleaner, but remains an information tool rather than direct protection.
